question: Are any of the 12 r28 periodic CTOIs explained by a known Kepler EB near the target?
catalogue: Kirk et al. 2016 Kepler EB catalogue, VizieR J/AJ/151/68 (not yet opened at freeze)
target_coords: TIC v8 via MAST for each target TIC (not yet fetched at freeze)
match_rule: EB within radius_arcsec of target with |P_EB/(h*P_CTOI) - 1| <= tolerance for some h in harmonics
self_rule: target KIC itself in EB catalogue: reported separately, not a blend attribution
chance_rule: lambda = mean count of catalogue EBs (excluding any control's own KIC) within radius over all r27 control positions x fraction of catalogue EBs whose period matches the target at any harmonic; chance = 1-exp(-lambda)
bar: Blend attributed if a match exists and chance < 0.01. Report count over 12 and over the 5 high-SNR rows.
